text:
noah reyes: Quick idea 3A small PLG play called 'ignite-loop' 34 test launch posts + 2-step onboarding nudge + tiny webinar. Objective: raise 7-day activation rate by moving users to an in-app prompt template run. Target audience: devs who click 'Get started' from socials. Thoughts?
emily cho: love it. keep it tight: 800 impressions, ~200 seeded users, 2 subject lines for email. who will own the credit gating?
noah reyes: @frank?
frank miller: I can. Proposed credit plan: 20 credits per user for 200 users = 4000 tokens reserve. I'll gate via feature flag `ignite_seed_v1`. Need a list from growth with emails to apply.
tess oda: Landing changes: compress signup to 2 fields, show 1-click "run starter prompt" on success page. I'll drop a quick variant with the button.
emily cho: Copy direction: pragmatic + urgent. Highlight "20 free credits + 3 starter prompts". Email A subject: "Get 20 free credits to try Redwood" Email B: "Build an AI feature tonight 34 20 credits inside"
samir patel: Analytics: funnel steps = click -> signup -> first prompt run -> first API call. We'll add a cohort tag `ignite_loop` and track `ignite.prompt_run` event. Add a retention check at 24h and 72h. If prompt_run < 30% pause the campaign.
campaign-bot: Heads-up: campaign scheduling requires 36 hours lead time. Confirm deployment window.
noah reyes: Timeline: prep Weds, soft send Thurs 10am PT to social + small email batch, measure 72h. Webinar Fri 12pm PT 34 15-min demo + 15 Qs.
frank miller: Tech note: backend will set `user.flags.ignite_seed = true` on grant and emit `ignite.credit_grant`. I'll open a small PR for the flag and credit service.
tess oda: UX ask: can we pre-select a starter prompt card on the success page so the CTA is "Run this template"? If yes, conversion should jump.
emily cho: We'll A/B test 1) CTA copy: "Run starter prompt" vs "Open example app", and 2) post-signup button placement. Two email subjects x 2 CTAs = 4 cells, keep n per cell >= 50.
samir patel: Also add a quick qualitative feedback widget after prompt run: "Was this output useful? (y/n)". We'll tie negative answers to an onboarding nudge flow.
noah reyes: Decision: go ahead. Seed 200 users @20 credits. @frank open PR, @tess ship landing variant, @emily drop email + social drafts by EOD. Campaign-bot 34 schedule check 36h before launch. :rocket:
campaign-bot: Scheduled check created for 36 hours prior to 2024-06-14T10:00:00Z.
frank miller: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842.
tess oda: Landing variant up on staging: /ignite-loop-staging. Button text options pushed.
emily cho: Drafts posted in #marketing-drafts channel, pinging design for final assets.
noah reyes: Nice. If we see >15% lift on prompt-run vs baseline, scale to 8k impressions next run. Otherwise iterate on prompt templates. Thanks everyone! :tada:
